title: Powershell: netps1
desc: A netcat-like CLI consolidating the TCP/UDP client and listener into one tool with two-way communication, raw file send/receive, and session logging (use -l to listen, -u for UDP, -s to send a file, -o to save received bytes, -Log to record a transcript)

title: Powershell: HTTPS Router
desc: Exposes a local HTTP or HTTPS (custom cert) port and forwards every connection to an HTTPS endpoint without validating the upstream certificate, letting a trusted local endpoint front an untrusted external TLS service

title: Bash: TCP Client
desc: A simple TCP client with two-way communication (similar to Ncat)
